documented_validation.ja: 正規化残差、SciPy spsolveとの相対解差、連続正弦解への離散L²型誤差、観測次数、operator complexityを保存します。節点順を無作為に置き換えた行列も直接解と照合し、幾何学的な粗格子を暗黙に使っていないことを確認します。反復予算0は未収束と報告します。
documented_validation.en: Store normalized residuals, relative solution differences against SciPy spsolve, discrete-L²-type continuum errors, observed order and operator complexity. A randomly permuted matrix is also checked against a direct solution to expose hidden geometric ordering assumptions. A zero cycle budget reports nonconvergence.

documented_limits.ja: 3格子の固定スカラー問題だけの確認です。係数の大きな不連続、強い異方性、弾性系、任意の非構造格子、最適計算量・格子独立収束を保証しません。小さい残差だけを小さい解誤差の証明としません。
documented_limits.en: Only three fixed scalar grids are checked. Large coefficient jumps, strong anisotropy, elasticity, arbitrary unstructured meshes, optimal complexity and mesh-independent convergence are not certified. A small residual alone does not prove a small solution error.

documented_validation.ja: QR/SVDの相対再構成誤差、Q/U/Vの直交性、SciPy LAPACK gesddの特異値、gelsd/gelsyの最小二乗解・階数、正規方程式の停留残差を比較します。特異ベクトルの符号は比較せず、零行列と予算切れも検査します。
documented_validation.en: Compare QR/SVD relative reconstruction, Q/U/V orthogonality, singular values from SciPy LAPACK gesdd, least-squares solutions/ranks from gelsd/gelsy and normal-equation stationarity residuals. Singular-vector signs are not compared; zero matrices and budget exhaustion are tested.

documented_limits.ja: 完全なLAPACK置換、複素行列、横長行列、任意の極端なスケール、最適な相対特異値精度を保証しません。10⁻¹²未満の特異値は入力した数値階数の規約で打ち切るため、数学的な厳密階数と区別します。Demmel–Veselićの精度定理の全条件を実証したとは主張しません。
documented_limits.en: Not a full LAPACK replacement or validation of complex/wide matrices, arbitrary extreme scales or optimal relative singular-value accuracy. The 10⁻¹² cutoff defines numerical rather than exact mathematical rank. The experiment does not establish all hypotheses of the Demmel–Veselić accuracy results.

documented_validation.ja: ||Av−λv||₂、独立密行列固有値との差、基底の直交性を保存し、Krylov次元を増やした末尾の改善を確認します。非対称Ritz値の単調収束は仮定しません。恒等行列のhappy breakdown、零初期ベクトル拒否、次元予算不足も検査します。
documented_validation.en: Store ||Av−λv||₂, differences from independently solved dense eigenvalues and basis orthogonality; verify final improvement as Krylov dimension grows. Nonsymmetric Ritz convergence is not assumed monotone. Tests include identity-matrix happy breakdown, zero-start rejection and insufficient dimension budgets.

documented_limits.ja: 非再始動・小行列・分離した極端固有対の教材です。内部固有値、クラスタ、巨大な疎行列、強い非正規性、shift-invertやimplicitly restarted Arnoldiは対象外です。小さな固有対残差だけで非正規行列の固有値誤差の厳密上界とはしません。
documented_limits.en: Unrestarted small-matrix educational examples with separated extreme eigenpairs. Interior/clustered eigenvalues, very large sparse matrices, strong nonnormality, shift-invert and implicitly restarted Arnoldi are outside scope. A small eigenpair residual alone is not treated as a rigorous eigenvalue-error bound for nonnormal matrices.

documented_validation.ja: 全指定次数の多項式モーメント、SciPy roots_legendreの節点・重みとの差、解析exp積分の次数収束、解析atan積分とSciPy quadへの一致を測ります。公差を厳しくしたときの評価数と誤差を示し、5評価の強制予算切れ、非有限関数値も検査します。
documented_validation.en: Measure polynomial moments for every chosen order, node/weight differences from SciPy roots_legendre, order refinement for the analytic exponential integral, and agreement with analytic arctangent and SciPy quad references. Store evaluation counts/errors as tolerance tightens; test forced exhaustion after five evaluations and nonfinite integrands.

documented_limits.ja: Simpsonの局所推定は任意の関数に対する厳密な誤差上界ではありません。高周波の見落とし、特異点、丸め誤差の停滞を一般に解決する実装ではなく、Gauss–KronrodやQUADPACK全体の再実装でもありません。
documented_limits.en: The local Simpson estimate is not a rigorous error bound for arbitrary functions. The implementation does not generally solve missed high frequencies, singularities or roundoff stagnation, and it is not a reimplementation of Gauss–Kronrod or all of QUADPACK.

documented_limits.ja: 固定seed・予算での統計検査です。ESSは平均という観測量だけ、Rhatはrank正規化版ではありません。多峰性・高次元・任意のseedでの混合や所定の偽陽性率は保証しません。
documented_limits.en: Statistical checks apply to fixed seeds and budgets. ESS concerns the mean only; Rhat is not rank-normalized. No guarantee covers multimodality, high dimensions, every seed, mixing or a specified false-positive rate.

documented_limits.en: Distribution checks use a harmonic potential and fixed seeds. Exact position variance does not remove finite-step momentum bias. Evidence does not transfer to other thermostats, general molecules or long ab initio MD.

documented_limits.ja: 3次元1/r核、適応木、周期FMM、特異積分、実測の計算量スケーリングは未検証です。2次元自由空間の教育用実装として表示します。

documented_validation.en: Separate a 32/64/128-grid sweep from timestep refinement on a 512 grid. Compare displacement amplitude with continuum linear cos(t), and check charge compatibility, potential-Poisson residual and single-particle self force.

documented_limits.ja: 有限振幅・有限粒子数の誤差床があります。非線形不安定性、Landau減衰、衝突、電磁PIC、相対論粒子、境界流入出の検証ではありません。

documented_validation.en: Use 512/2048/8192 particles and sixteen seeds to check momentum/energy, Maxwell second/fourth moments and the Gamma(3/2,1) energy CDF. Independently check the expected per-round anisotropy factor (N−2)/(2(N−1)). The finite-N component fourth moment is 3−6/(3N−1); distinguish that finite-particle offset from the across-seed sampling uncertainty.

documented_limits.en: Face CT divergence and centered GLM divergence use different operators; common cell-centered diagnostics are also reported. Athena initializes face-averaged magnetic fields by differencing a vector potential, so comparison includes discretization differences of identical continuous data. This is a short planar test, not validation of shocks, 3D, UCT or CTU.

The 2048-to-4096 reference L1 increment0.005346 missed the predeclared0.005 bound, so8192 cells were added. The earlier miss remains recorded.

documented_validation.ja: 参照は同じFD半離散系を実空間の疎行列・別記述の反応RHSで組み、分割せずRadauで積分した数値解です。Radauの公差細分化と別のDOP853で参照自身の差を測り、最細Strang誤差との比を判定します。ノルムは成分ごとの平均L1・RMS L2・最大L∞を求めて悪い成分を採用し、4つの正の共通出力時刻の最大値で次数を測定。Newton公差感度、全副段階の正濃度、反応source/sink収支と逆順Lieの対照も記録します。
documented_validation.en: The reference independently assembles the SAME FD semidiscretization with a real-space sparse matrix and separately written reaction RHS, then integrates it unsplit with Radau. Tighter Radau and separate DOP853 runs measure reference sensitivity relative to the finest Strang error. Norms are per-species mean L1, RMS L2 and maximum L∞, then the worse species; refinement uses the maximum across the four common positive observation times. Also record Newton-tolerance sensitivity, positive tested substeps, reaction source/sink balance and reversed-Lie ordering.

documented_limits.ja: 固定格子での採用合成法の時間誤差であり、分割誤差と反応中点則の離散誤差を含みます。連続PDEの厳密解・空間収束・独立PDE実装の照合とは呼びません。u+vは反応で保存せず、正濃度は固定入力での観測です。計算費は実際の部分流呼出し数で示し、速度の順位やStrangの一般的優越を主張しません。既存Schnakenberg問題の追加比較で、物理問題数・共通22例・旧配布版の公差や成功履歴を増減・変更しません。長時間パターン・2D・一般境界は対象外です。
documented_limits.en: This measures temporal error of the adopted compositions at fixed space, including splitting and midpoint-reaction discretization errors. It is not an exact continuum solution, spatial convergence check or independent PDE-engine comparison. Reactions do not conserve u+v; positivity is observed only for the fixed input. Work is reported as actual subflow calls, without runtime rankings or universal Strang superiority. This additional comparison of the existing Schnakenberg problem changes neither physical-problem counts, the common 22 examples, old release criteria nor success history. Long-time patterns, 2D and general boundaries are outside scope.

documented_validation.ja: 旧平面・円筒の受入基準と59判定を保持し、球の追加基準・入力・ソースhashを初回の球PDE実行前に保存します。初回の円筒不合格はソース・全8本の診断ログ・不合格サマリーを保持し、同じ基準で面応力版を再検証した履歴です。厳密保存量セル平均は衝撃をまたぐ積分を分割し、p(平均U)と平均pを分けます。固定版LANL ExactPackの独立解析照合はd=1/2/3を含みます。球の新規PDE系列では全域r²重みL1/L2/L∞、原点を含むr≤.70rsの密度L1、原点・衝撃・plateauを別測定。各段の境界流入による離散保存収支と、連続解析総量との差を分け、M_h−M_exact=Σdt³/6、E_h−E_exact=Σdt³/12というSSPRK2境界求積の恒等式を検査します。 最初の球対称実行は旧算術平均源のまま105条件中2条件で不合格（最細衝撃位置3.923セル、plateau密度誤差11.03%）となり、全結果を保存しました。第2試行は球の面応力求積だけを変更しましたが、同じ2条件が未達（衝撃位置3.919セル、密度誤差11.018%）でした。第3試行はその求積を保ち、球だけMUSCL・minmod再構築を加えて、同じ105条件で比較します。 第3試行は28検査と全12格子計算を完了し、105条件すべてに合格しました。球N=512では全域密度L1=.0114343、衝撃位置誤差1.98856セル、plateau密度誤差5.2533%、原点込みcore密度L1=.0549503です。一方、中心最大比内部エネルギーの相対過剰は20.59%で、第2試行の15.52%より悪化しており、全指標の改善は主張しません。
documented_validation.en: Retain the planar/cylindrical acceptance file and all 59 original decisions, and save spherical criteria, inputs and source hashes before the first spherical PDE run. The initial cylindrical failure retains its source, all eight diagnostic logs and failed summary; the face-stress revision was tested against the same gates. Analytic conserved means split shock-crossing integrals and distinguish p(mean U) from mean p. The pinned independent LANL ExactPack analytic comparison includes d=1/2/3. New spherical PDE refinements separately measure full-domain r^2-weighted L1/L2/Linf, density L1 in r<=.70rs including the origin, and center/shock/plateau diagnostics. Discrete stage-weighted inflow budgets are distinct from continuous analytic totals; SSPRK2 boundary quadrature is checked through M_h-M_exact=sum(dt^3)/6 and E_h-E_exact=sum(dt^3)/12. The first spherical run retained arithmetic source quadrature and failed two of 105 gates (finest shock-position error 3.923 cells, plateau-density error 11.03%); all results are retained. A second attempt changed only spherical stress quadrature, but still failed the same two gates (3.919 cells and 11.018% density error). A third attempt retains that quadrature and adds MUSCL/minmod reconstruction only for spherical runs, against the same 105 criteria. The third attempt completed 28 tests and all 12 grid runs, passing all 105 gates. At spherical N=512 the whole-domain density L1 is .0114343, shock error 1.98856 cells, plateau-density error 5.2533%, and origin-inclusive core-density L1 .0549503. Maximum center specific-internal-energy excess is 20.59%, worse than the second attempt's 15.52%; not every diagnostic improves.

documented_limits.ja: 平面・円筒は空間一次、球はMUSCL型の制限線形再構築を使う教育用計算です。原点過熱と有限格子のplateau誤差が残り、全域誤差から原点を除外しません。r²重みで中心欠陥が小さく見えるため、原点を含む固定coreの誤差と拡大図も示します。L∞や中心最大誤差のゼロ収束、滑らかな球問題での方式全体の高次精度、幾何源付き全RK段階の一般の正値性保証、Cartesian多次元、任意γの独立照合は検証していません。円筒L∞は旧系列で単調減少せず、球のL2/L∞と過熱も診断値として保持します。球の離散質量・エネルギー収支が丸め誤差でも、解析総量との差は境界時間求積のO(dt²)となります。半径方向の運動量には幾何源があり、保存されるCartesian運動量とは異なります。ExactPackは解析評価器の独立実装で、別の数値PDEエンジンではありません。
documented_limits.en: An educational calculation: first-order space in planar/cylindrical flow and MUSCL-type limited linear reconstruction in spherical flow. Origin heating and finite-grid plateau errors remain; the center is never removed from whole-domain error. Because r^2 weighting can make central defects appear small, an origin-inclusive fixed-core norm and enlarged view are also shown. Vanishing Linf/center maximum error, high order for the complete method on smooth spherical problems, general stage positivity with the geometric source, Cartesian multidimensional flow and independent arbitrary-gamma validation are not established. Cylindrical Linf was not monotone in the old series; spherical L2/Linf and heating are retained as diagnostics. Roundoff-scale discrete mass/energy balance coexists with O(dt^2) spherical boundary-time-quadrature error against analytic totals. Radial momentum has a geometric source and is not a conserved Cartesian momentum component. ExactPack independently implements the analytic evaluator, not another numerical PDE engine.

documented_validation.en: Inputs/source/acceptance hashes are saved before execution. All 19 unit tests and 49 gates on three grids passed at the first attempt. Analytic density is integrated over cells by splitting shock-circle cuts and 64-point Gauss quadrature with x=rs sin(theta), checked against 128 points and analytic total mass; these are quadrature references, not closed-form exact cell means. At 128², full-square density L1=.09981, origin-inclusive core L1=.12231; shock errors are.968 axis cells and1.469 diagonal cells. Maximum relative discrete-budget residual is about 4.6e-15. D4 conserved parity and continuous rotational symmetry are measured separately.

documented_limits.ja: 空間一次の軽量例で、原点過熱と衝撃層の誤差が残ります。最細格子でも中心最大比内部エネルギーは厳密値より約14%高いままです。軸・対角の衝撃半径差は約.501Δxで、3格子間で単調には減りません。D4偶奇性が丸め誤差でも円対称性が厳密という意味ではありません。一般の摂動安定性・原点位置ずらし・回転格子・3D Cartesian・高次精度は未検証です。旧1D平面/円筒/球の配布版と判定は変更しません。
documented_limits.en: A first-order-space lightweight example retains origin heating and shock errors. Finest maximum center specific internal energy is still about 14% high. Axis/diagonal shock-radius difference is about .501dx and is not monotone over these grids. Roundoff-level D4 parity does not establish exact circular symmetry. General perturbation stability, displaced origins, rotated meshes, 3D Cartesian flow and high-order accuracy are unverified. Earlier planar/cylindrical/spherical 1D editions and gates remain unchanged.

documented_validation.ja: 初版r1はMacで22単体検査・48判定が合格しましたが、公開ZIPのLinux追試では警告を例外にする設定でCFL比のoverflowにより失敗しました。r2は代数的に等価な逆数最大率へ評価順を変更し、元の入力・参照・受入基準48条件を維持。r2専用の実行前hash契約を保存してから、警告を例外にした23検査と全4計算・48判定が合格しました。初版のソース・契約・Linux失敗記録も保存しています。参照は独立な相似ODEのDOP853積分、エネルギー規格化、中心ξ<.001の正則漸近形と衝撃位置で分割する殻求積です。16/32点求積・中心cutoff/ODE公差を別々に確認。固定commitの未改変ExactPackを6001/12001点で別実行し、中心とジャンプから離れた点を事前基準5e-4で照合しました。β=1.15166641793、Rs(.05)=.34746791233。原点・衝撃波を含むr≤1.2Rsの体積重み密度L1は.17257/.12785/.07458、圧力L1は.18148/.13939/.07615。512セルの衝撃位置誤差は1.096セル、最大離散収支残差は約8.89e-16です。
documented_validation.en: Original r1 passed22 tests and48 gates on Mac, but its public-ZIP Linux run failed when warnings-as-errors raised a cold-tail CFL overflow. Revision r2 uses the algebraically equivalent reciprocal maximum-rate evaluation while preserving the original inputs, reference and48 acceptance gates. A new r2-specific pre-execution hash contract precedes23 tests and all four calculations/48 gates passing with warnings as errors. Original sources, contract and actual Linux-failure evidence remain archived. The independent reference integrates the similarity ODE with DOP853, normalizes energy, uses a regular asymptote for xi<.001 and split shell quadrature at the shock. Orders16/32, core cutoff and ODE tolerance are checked separately. The unmodified pinned ExactPack evaluator was independently run at6001/12001 points and compared away from the center/jump with its preregistered5e-4 criterion.
